missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Грех' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Большой' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A simple model for moral statements.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Грех' is the accusative direct object of 'совершил'; as an inanimate masculine noun its accusative matches the nominative. 'Тяжкий' agrees in the masculine accusative.

missions.phrase: Он попросил прощения за свой грех.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative with preposition. 'Грех' is accusative after 'за', the thing one is forgiven for. 'Свой' agrees in the masculine accusative. A religious or moral context.

missions.phrase: У каждого человека есть свои грехи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Грехи' is the nominative plural subject in the possession frame 'есть'. 'Свои' is the agreeing possessive. A common reflective observation.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'Грехах' is the prepositional plural after 'о', the topic of the sermon. 'Наших' agrees in the prepositional plural. Useful for reported speech.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Греха' takes the genitive after 'нет', denying existence. 'Никакого' reinforces the negation in the genitive. A reassuring everyday phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Грехе' is prepositional after 'в', the thing repented of. 'Своём' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A formal moral pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Грехом' is the instrumental complement of 'считается', stating what envy is regarded as. 'Смертным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.

missions.phrase: Он много грешит и боится греха.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive object. 'Греха' is genitive after 'боится', since 'бояться' governs the genitive. The verb 'грешит' echoes the same root for variety.

missions.phrase: Люди прощают друг другу старые грехи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Грехи' is the accusative plural object of 'прощают', the things forgiven. 'Старые' agrees in the accusative plural. A theme of reconciliation.
